name: xeros
description: Xéros — jeu d'aventure en pixel art (Phaser 3 + TypeScript)

scripts.check: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/check.ts
scripts.dev: npm run art && npm run maps && vite
scripts.typecheck: npm run art && npm run maps && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run art && npm run test:fast
scripts.test:fast: tsx tools/test-sketch.ts && tsx tools/test-build.ts && tsx tools/test-sections.ts && tsx tools/test-crossing.ts && tsx tools/test-clock.ts && tsx tools/test-stamina.ts && tsx tools/test-sleep.ts && tsx tools/test-swing.ts
scripts.test:scenarios: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/run-scenarios.ts
scripts.test:fendage: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-fendage.ts
scripts.test:implantation: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-implantation.ts
scripts.test:equarrissage: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-equarrissage.ts
scripts.test:tas: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-tas.ts
scripts.test:perspective: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-perspective.ts
scripts.test:poteaux: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-poteaux.ts
scripts.test:briques: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-briques.ts
scripts.test:construction: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-construction.ts
scripts.test:cabane: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-cabane.ts
scripts.test:grange: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-grange.ts
scripts.test:etal: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-etal.ts
scripts.test:interieur: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-interieur.ts
scripts.test:monde: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-monde.ts && tsx tools/test-combat.ts
scripts.art:monde: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/world-preview.ts
scripts.test:combat: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-combat.ts
scripts.test:temps: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-temps.ts
scripts.test:reset: npm run art && npm run maps && tsx tools/test-reset.ts
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run test:fast && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:single: npm run check && npm run test:fast && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode single
